# Arcadeum

> Free online board games — play with friends in your browser. No download, no signup.

Arcadeum is a browser-based multiplayer platform for classic board games. Create a private room, share the link, and play instantly.

## Core Games

- [Sea Battle (Battleship)](https://arcadeum.games/en/games/sea-battle): Classic naval combat strategy for 2–6 players
- [Critical](https://arcadeum.games/en/games/critical): Strategic card game — draw, defuse, survive for 3–5 players
- [Tic-Tac-Toe](https://arcadeum.games/en/games/tic-tac-toe): Six themed variants for 2–5 players
- [Cascade](https://arcadeum.games/en/games/cascade): Shedding card game with stacking chains for 2–10 players
- [Chess](https://arcadeum.games/en/games/chess): Classic strategy game for 2 players
- [Glimworm](https://arcadeum.games/en/games): Real-time glow-worm snake arena for 2–10 players

## Features

- Private multiplayer rooms with shareable links
- AI bots for solo practice
- Real-time chat during gameplay
- Player profiles, statistics, and leaderboards
- Daily rewards and cosmetic shop
- Available in English, Spanish, French, Russian, and Belarusian
